credentialScope: Dedicated nonproduction Product membership with object-scoped import/read permissions, not production admin; effective authorization must be proven read-only first
protocol: multipart POST /api/v2/import-scan/; actual real HTTPS/trusted-origin transport not enabled this stage
sourceBindingNote: The two real finding sources are distinct prior runs, not one same-run proof. Mixed HTTP sample is explicitly FIXTURE. No new scanner/runtime facts.
suggestedFirstRealBatch: One approved immutable Candidate at a time, at most two source reports/Tests; authorize its exact source seal, request digests, empty-report behavior and counts before sending
reimport: NOT_ENABLED; future explicit Test binding, close_old_findings=false and do_not_reactivate=true require separate validation
dedupe: NOT_ESTABLISHED on actual instance; query + stable Finding identity supports recovery evidence only, no atomic exactly-once guarantee
requiredChecks: Actual nonproduction Product ID/name and access isolation
Existing Development environment or approved environment name without auto-create
Dedicated identity effective scope and protected credential channel
Real target origin/TLS trust and explicit approval
Serial per-request journal ownership and cross-client concurrency policy
Retain or explicitly delete only created Test/Finding IDs
cleanupDecision: UNAPPROVED; no automatic cleanup against real instance
cleanupProposal: If separately authorized, query exact created IDs and request/result provenance; delete only this batch-owned objects after cross-project/history checks, never bulk close history
failureRollback: Disable explicit HTTP entry; retain immutable result and append-only receipts, do not automatically retry an uncertain mutation or delete remote objects
auditEvidence: Exact response object IDs and read-only reconciliation evidence
onlyNextAction: Legitimately establish the actual dedicated nonproduction Product/Engagement and least-privilege identity via authorized read-only evidence, then request explicit bounded real delivery approval; no writes while any item is missing
